description.fun: Unovan legend tells of a single dragon that split in two: Reshiram sided with a hero who sought truth, Zekrom with his brother who sought ideals, and their clash devastated the region. When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather, and myth says it burns down kingdoms ruled by greed. Ken Sugimori says its name starts with a soft 'Re' to contrast with Zekrom's hard 'Ze'.
description.guide: Reshiram is a Dragon- and Fire-type Legendary Pokémon from Unova's legends that helps those who seek a world of truth. It is the counterpart of Zekrom and can fuse with Kyurem to form White Kyurem.
description.tagline: The white dragon of truth whose fire changes the weather.
